findings.title: Payment is simulated: no gateway, no credential capture, no verification

evidence.requestContract: CheckoutRequest has exactly three fields: slotId, method (BKASH|NAGAD|CARD|CASH), applyWalletAmount. No PAN/account/PIN/OTP field exists, so the bKash sheet in the UI cannot be transmitting anything.

steps: Inspect AdminPartBDataSeeder: seeding is triggered from @PostConstruct
Part A (users/venues/pitches) is created by CommandLineRunner beans, which run AFTER all @PostConstruct callbacks
Start the app and read the log; then GET /api/v1/admin/payouts

findings.actual: backend log says 'Cannot run Part B Seeder: required Part A data (Users/Venues/Pitches) is missing.'; GET /admin/payouts returned 200 with 0 rows

evidence.consequence: Admin payouts, 12-month GMV history and audit-log demo data are always empty, so admin analytics fall back to fabricated values.
